name: Can a small bathroom be remodeled without making it feel crowded?

mainEntity.name: Can a small bathroom be remodeled without making it feel crowded?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, a small bathroom can feel larger with the right layout, lighting, mirror size, and storage choices. A floating vanity, glass shower enclosure, lighter finishes, and recessed storage can all improve the sense of space. The key is to avoid oversized fixtures that consume valuable floor area.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes. Use a better layout, lighter finishes, glass shower doors, mirrors, and space-saving storage to make a small bathroom feel bigger.
